description: Cross-reference competitor ad patterns against the user's own strong-performing creatives and psychological hook analysis to find cross-source overlap, own-account test gaps, and market whitespace. Use whenever the user wants to know what to actually build next — after competitor research and/or own-creative diagnosis have already run, or when they explicitly ask "what should we test" or "what's the whitespace." This is a synthesis skill — it consumes the outputs of competitor-ad-intelligence, own-creative-diagnosis, and creative-psychology-hooks rather than pulling new data itself.
